USD.key_read: Coherent dovish/easing regimes show the clearest OOS transmission; hawkish transmission is materially weaker.

CAD.key_read: Coherent macro/inflation states are promising, but samples remain too small for a rates gate.

GBP.key_read: OIS/front-end confirmation does not reliably improve the coherent macro state OOS.

JPY.key_read: JGB 2Y/relative rates are useful transmission context but not a mechanical conviction upgrade.

EUR.key_read: Existing wages/front-end walk-forward does not establish robust incremental value.

AUD.key_read: Dual-mandate replay is promising, particularly hawkish, but only 9 coherent events / 6 OOS and 2Y+price confirmation is too sparse for promotion.

NZD.key_read: Official Stats NZ/RBNZ data are identified, but reproducible historical materialization is blocked by source access in the available runner.

CHF.key_read: Swiss 2Y, CPI timing and official SNB FX transactions are certified; the remaining blocker is contemporaneous SECO seasonally-adjusted unemployment vintages. Legacy releases are publicly browser-accessible but blocked to the project runner.

cross_currency_conclusion.preferred_architecture: Macro state -> currency-specific central-bank reaction function -> front-end/relative-rates transmission -> price confirmation -> qualitative transmission state
